quests.title: Halloumi or Hellim?
quests.summary: Pyla's two coffee-house owners each say his is the best halloumi on the island. The UN doesn't do cheese, so you'll have to.

steps.text: Taste Andreas's halloumi in Pyla's kafeneio.
Taste Hüseyin's hellim in Pyla's kahvehane.
Ask the halloumi seller in the square of south Nicosia.
Cross at Ledra Street and ask the hellim seller in the Büyük Han. A food critic may need persuading.
Take the verdict back to the UN peacekeeper in Pyla.

quests.reward: Halloumi, Loukoumades, Şeftali Kebab and standing with the Overseas Territories.

quests.title: A Good Eye
quests.summary: A Forestry Department ranger has a young agrino, the Cypriot mouflon, that needs a keeper with patience.

steps.text: Catch a Chamelet (the fields round Pyla are a good start) and show the ranger in the taverna in south Nicosia.

quests.reward: An Agrino, the mouflon of Cyprus, and standing with the Overseas Territories.
